Access Ticket statuses Agent availability Data sharing for tickets The default access to tickets owned by other agents. Private Current Agents see and edit the tickets they own, their teams' tickets and their subordinates' tickets — plus unassigned tickets when their profile allows it. Public Read Only Agents see every ticket in the public scope below, but edit only what Private would let them edit. Public Read/Write/Delete Agents see and edit every ticket in the public scope below. Their profile still decides which actions they may take. All changes saved Save Public reach and peer sharing How far public access reaches, and which roles let their members read each other's tickets. Public access scope How far "public" reaches — for the public data sharing levels and for the unassigned pool. Whole organization Public access and unassigned tickets reach every department. Agent's departments Current Public access and unassigned tickets reach only the departments the agent belongs to. Share data with peers Agents in a ticked role can read — not edit — the tickets owned by the other agents in the same role. 0 of 2 roles Select all Clear CEO Manager All changes saved Save Who sees which tickets How the settings above combine. An agent reaches a ticket when any line applies. 1 Their own tickets Every ticket the agent owns — always, read and edit. 2 Their teams' tickets Tickets owned by a team the agent belongs to and not yet taken by anyone — read and edit. 3 Unassigned tickets Tickets with no owner and no team, within the public access scope — only with the "View unassigned tickets" permission. 4 Reporting staff Tickets owned by agents in the roles below theirs — read and edit. 5 Peers Tickets owned by agents in the same role, when that role shares data with peers — read only. 6 Shared tickets Tickets shared with a department the agent belongs to — read only. 7 Public access With Public Read Only or Public Read/Write/Delete, every ticket in the public access scope — read, and edit with Read/Write/Delete. 8 Every department Holders of "Access tickets in every department" reach every ticket, read and edit.
